name: french_rag_evaluation_v1
description: Evaluation dataset for French RAG system (Osiris/Brussels urban planning worksites). Replace placeholder IDs with actual document/chunk UUIDs from your database.

metadata.instructions: To populate expected_doc_ids: 1) Run each query against your indexed documents, 2) Manually identify the most relevant chunks, 3) Copy their UUIDs here
